description: This file defines a Flutter widget called SwipeDeck that provides a swipeable card interface, showing one card at a time and allowing users to like or dislike each card through buttons. When a button is pressed, an external callback is triggered, and the deck advances to the next card.

classes.name: SwipeDeck
classes.description: A minimal swipe deck widget that displays a list of cards and handles swipe interactions via buttons.

classes.name: _SwipeDeckState
classes.description: The internal state class managing the current index of the card being displayed and handling user interactions.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the SwipeDeck widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the swipe deck, displaying the current card and action buttons.

methods.name: _advance
methods.description: Advances the deck to the next card and triggers the onSwipe callback.
